fullContent:
Vacha Lasunadi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Sharangdhara Samhita Madhyamakhanda 9/198, Sahasrayogam. 
 Vacha Lasunadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic herbal oil. Use of this oil is very good to treat the ear problems such as infection or external injury. It is used for head massage and also as ear drops. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Vacha – Sweet flag (rhizome) – Acorus calamus – 64 g 
 Garlic – Alium sativum – 64 g 
 Turmeric – Curcuma longa – 64 g 
 Bael (root) – Aegle marmelos – juice extract – 3.072 liters 
 Taila – Oil of Sesamum indicum – 768 ml 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Vacha Lasunadi Thailam is an herbal oil meant to manage the ear problems. This herbal oil possesses the antiseptic, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory and healing properties. Instilling the drops of this oil in ear is quite good to lessen the pain and swelling. Also quite effective to ward off the various problems of ear like injuries and infections. This oil works well to clear the pus as it possesses healing properties. 
 Indications 
 It is used to relieve pus collection, relieve ear injuries, ear discharge and related ear problems and catarrah. It is also good for head problems. 
 How to use? 
 It is used for external application only and as ear drops. 5 – 6 drops are instilled into the ears. 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no apparent side effects with this medicine, on external application. 
 Self-medication with this oil is discouraged. 
 For pregnant ladies and children this medicine should be avoided. 
 Keep out of sight and reach of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
